rationale: Public Land Order 1491 (22 FR 7311, signed 1957-09-09) expressly revokes Executive Order 8305 as amended and modified, for all of its lands, and its Federal Register text is held and prints the order's number. The only own-terms condition ever attached to the order (the 1945 sunset paragraph) was deleted in 1950 before it could operate, and the 1951 transfer was a partial amendment. The 1989 codification row (an excluded public-lands category) does not show the order in force. The order was therefore not in force on 2026-10-14.
